name: QR Scan
tagline: Read a code from a still photo. Nothing is uploaded.
description:
Take a still photo or choose a picture already on this device. The words inside the code appear on the screen. There is no live camera — one picture at a time, on this device. Nothing is sent anywhere, and there is no account.

A short history of what you have read stays in this file. It never leaves this device. A friend who opens the same app in a meeting keeps their own history.

Unofficial port of jsQR by cozmo. For making a code, use QR Code. For a Wi-Fi fridge card, use WiFi Card.
